name: Avalue Technology Incorporation
summary: Avalue Technology Incorporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacturing, processing, import, and export of industrial computers in Taiwan, the Americas, Europe, Asia, and internationally. It operates in two segments, Embedded Computer and Industrial Computer. The company offers industrial and embedded motherboard; computer-on-module; computing system; embedded peripheral; panel PC/monitor/mobile; intelligent healthcare; digital paper; computing products; AI computing platforms; and IoT solution, as well as after-sales services.
